data.action: 站在湿滑站台上，将透明雨伞向刚下车的人侧倾
data.description: 暴雨倾盆的龙门城际列车站台边缘，陈撑着一把透明雨伞静静等候在雨幕之中，雨滴在伞面上敲击出密集的鼓点。看到列车舱门打开走出的你，她快步上前将伞倾斜过去——「路上辛苦了。车已经备好，我们直接回近卫局。」
data.lighting: 车门内的暖光落在湿地，站台冷光打亮伞上的雨珠
data.promptProse: At Lungmen station, Ch’en stands a step back from the yellow strip beside the rails, one hand in her charcoal trench coat pocket. She tilts a single clear umbrella toward the arriving passenger beside the camera. The train runs away behind her, its amber-lit windows reflected under the canopy columns and along the wet platform. Cool rain outlines the umbrella rim while warm carriage light reaches the pleats of her coat. The three-quarter view includes her face, the umbrella and the far end of the platform.
data.title: 陈 · 雨夜车站
data.animaCaption: There is a single open umbrella. She tips its clear canopy toward the viewer with the hand on its shaft, her other hand tucked into her coat pocket. Amber carriage windows recede down the wet platform.
